meta.title: OPINION — Every opinion has another side
meta.description: An interactive philosophical project about opinions, opposites, and choices. Turn the sides, explore different points of view, and try to see beyond your own perspective.
meta.keywords: OPINION, opinion, point of view, philosophy, interactive project, perspectives, pessimism, optimism, 3D cube, kotarsis

instruction.description:
This project is best experienced
without trying to find the right answer.
instruction.philosophy:
Every opinion has another side.
To see it, turn the page.
instruction.swipe: Swipe in any direction – with your finger or mouse.
instruction.keyboard: On a computer, you can also use arrow keys or WASD.

outro.title: Every opinion has another side.
outro.description: But none of them has to be yours.
outro.sides: Maybe it's not about choosing a side.
outro.seen: But about learning to see them all.

bottom.title: As always, humanity came up with a simple solution.
bottom.subline: Just divide people into two categories.

back.title: Did you really choose a side?

left.title: Most opinions are better left unspoken.

arguments.people:
People are busy with their own lives. 
They don't care what you think.
arguments.dispute:
Most arguments don't lead to truth. 
They only produce a winner.
arguments.silence:
Sometimes silence is 
the only mature opinion.

right.title: Without other people's opinions, humanity would never have changed.

arguments.people:
Every idea began 
as someone's opinion.
arguments.dispute:
If people had stayed silent, 
the world would still be standing still.
arguments.silence:
Even if people disagree with you, 
your words might make them think.

footer.title: Maybe there was never a right side.
